raw_text:
Below is a 12-week strength + hypertrophy program starting 2026-06-01, designed for a recreational lifter on a combined oral contraceptive (no cycle phasing needed). Goal: build foundational strength in the main lifts while driving hypertrophy for favorable body composition. Structure emphasizes progressive overload, smart volume progression, technique, and recovery. Assumes access to a full gym. 

Overview
- Duration: 12 weeks (2026-06-01 to 2026-08-23)
- Training days: 4 days/week (Upper/Lower splits with undulation)
- Phases:
  - Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Base and Hypertrophy Foundation
  - Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength Emphasis with Hypertrophy Support
  - Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak Strength + Hypertrophy Consolidation
- Conditioning: 1–2 short sessions/week (10–20 minutes) + daily steps
- Mobility: 10–12 minutes/session
- Progression: Double progression on accessories; load progression on compounds
- RPE guidance: Compounds RPE 6–9 depending on week; accessories RPE 8–9
- Deload in Week 9 Day 4? Instead, we’ll use a volume taper Week 9 Day 1–2? To keep clarity: planned “reload” in Week 9 is not needed; we’ll integrate micro-deloads: Week 4 and Week 8 reduce accessory volume slightly.

Weekly Schedule Template
- Mon: Lower A (Squat focus)
- Tue: Upper A (Horizontal push/pull focus)
- Thu: Lower B (Hinge/Deadlift focus)
- Fri: Upper B (Vertical push/pull + arms/shoulders)
- Optional Conditioning: Sat (zone 2) or post-lift finishers
- Active Recovery: Wed or Sun (walks, mobility)

Session Structure (each day)
- Prep (10–12 min): 3–5 min easy cardio, dynamic mobility (hips/shoulders/ankles/T-spine), movement prep specific to main lifts
- Main Lift(s): 1–2 big compounds
- Secondary/Accessory: 4–6 movements targeting hypertrophy and balance
- Finisher/Conditioning (optional): 5–12 minutes
- Cooldown: Light cardio 3–5 min + breathing

Key Notation
- RPE: Rate of Perceived Exertion (10 = max)
- Rest: Compounds 2–3+ min; accessories 60–90 s
- Tempo guidance where helpful (e.g., 3-1-1 = 3s eccentric, 1s pause, 1s up)

Phase 1: Base & Hypertrophy Foundation (Weeks 1–4)
Goals: Groove technique, accumulate quality volume, build work capacity, set rep max baselines. RPE 6–8 on compounds; accessories RPE ~8.

Week 1 (2026-06-01)
- Lower A (Mon)
  - Back Squat 4x6 @ RPE 6–7
  - Romanian Deadlift 3x8 @ RPE 7
  - Walking Lunge 3x10/leg @ RPE 8
  - Leg Curl (machine) 3x12
  - Leg Press Calf Raise 3x12–15
  - Core: Dead Bug 3x10/side
- Upper A (Tue)
  - Flat Barbell Bench Press 4x6 @ RPE 6–7
  - 1-Arm DB Row 3x10/side
  - Incline DB Press 3x10
  - Chest-Supported Row 3x10–12
  - Cable Fly 2x12–15
  - DB Lateral Raise 3x12–15
- Lower B (Thu)
  - Conventional Deadlift 4x4 @ RPE 6–7
  - Front Squat 3x6 @ RPE 7
  - Hip Thrust 3x10
  - Split Squat (rear-foot elevated optional) 3x8/leg
  - Seated Calf Raise 3x12–15
  - Core: Side Plank 3x30–45s/side
- Upper B (Fri)
  - Overhead Press 4x5 @ RPE 6–7
  - Pull-Up (assisted as needed) 4x6–8 total reps; stop 2 reps shy of failure
  - Close-Grip Bench or Dips 3x8
  - Lat Pulldown (wide or neutral) 3x10–12
  - Cable Face Pull 3x12–15
  - Cable Curl + Rope Triceps Pressdown 2x12–15 superset

Conditioning: 1 x 12–20 min Zone 2 (bike/row) on Sat or after Upper A. Steps: 7.5–10k/day.

Week 2
- Progress load 2–2.5% on compounds if all sets hit target RPE; otherwise repeat and add 1 rep where possible.
- Keep same exercises/sets/reps as Week 1; accessories: attempt +1 rep/set (stay in ranges).

Week 3
- Compounds: Squat 5x5 @ RPE 7; Bench 5x5 @ RPE 7; Deadlift 5x3 @ RPE 7; OHP 5x4 @ RPE 7.
- Accessories: maintain Week 1–2 selection; aim upper end of rep ranges.

Week 4 (slight volume taper for freshness)
- Reduce accessory sets by ~20–25%, keep intensity similar.
- Compounds:
  - Back Squat 3x6 @ RPE 7
  - Bench Press 3x6 @ RPE 7
  - Deadlift 3x3 @ RPE 7
  - OHP 3x5 @ RPE 7

Phase 2: Strength Emphasis with Hypertrophy Support (Weeks 5–8)
Goals: Drive strength up in squat/bench/dead/OHP while maintaining hypertrophy volume. RPE 7–9 on compounds, accessories RPE 8–9. Introduce pause work and heavier top sets.

Week 5
- Lower A
  - Back Squat: Top set 1x5 @ RPE 8, then 3x5 @ ~90% of top set
  - RDL 3x6–8 @ RPE 8
  - Hack Squat or Leg Press 3x10
  - Nordic Curl or Lying Curl 3x8–10
  - Standing Calf Raise 3x10–12
  - Core: Hanging Knee Raise 3x10–12
- Upper A
  - Bench Press: Top set 1x4–5 @ RPE 8, then 3x4–5 @ 90%
  - DB Row 4x8–10 heavy
  - Incline DB Press 3x8–10
  - Chest-Supported Row 3x8–10
  - Pec Deck or Cable Fly 2–3x12–15
  - Lateral Raise 3x12–15
- Lower B
  - Deadlift: Top set 1x3 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ 90%
  - Front Squat 3x4–6 @ RPE 8
  - Hip Thrust 4x6–8 heavy
  - Split Squat 3x8/leg
  - Seated Calf Raise 3x10–12
  - Core: Pallof Press 3x10/side
- Upper B
  - Overhead Press: Top set 1x3–4 @ RPE 8, then 3x3–4 @ 90%
  - Pull-Ups 4xAMRAP leaving 1–2 reps in reserve
  - Close-Grip Bench or Dips 3x6–8
  - Lat Pulldown 3x8–10
  - Face Pull 3x12–15
  - EZ-Bar Curl superset Rope Pressdown 3x10–12 each

Week 6
- Aim +2.5–5 kg on big lifts if RPE last week was ≤8; otherwise add one rep to back-off sets.
- Keep accessory selections; push toward top of rep ranges. 

Week 7
- Introduce pause work:
  - Squat: 1-count pause in the hole for back-off sets (2x4 @ ~85% of top set after 1x4 @ RPE 8)
  - Bench: 1-count paused bench for back-offs (same scheme)
  - Deadlift: 2x3 paused at mid-shin @ ~80% after top set 1x3 @ RPE 8
  - OHP: strict, no leg drive; microload if needed
- Accessories unchanged; maintain effort.

Week 8 (slight volume taper)
- Keep top sets as Week 7 but reduce back-off volume by ~25% (e.g., 2 back-off sets instead of 3; accessories drop 1 set each).
- RPE cap 8 on compounds.

Phase 3: Peak Strength + Hypertrophy Consolidation (Weeks 9–12)
Goals: Convert volume to strength, maintain lean mass accrual, manage fatigue. Slightly lower accessory volume, higher quality loads on compounds. RPE 7–9 with strategic singles.

Week 9
- Lower A
  - Back Squat: 1x3 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ 90%
  - RDL 3x5–6 heavy
  - Leg Press 3x8–10
  - Leg Curl 3x8–10
  - Calves 3x10–12
  - Core: Weighted Plank 3x30–45s
- Upper A
  - Bench: 1x3 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ 90%
  - DB Row 3x8 heavy
  - Incline DB Press 3x8–10
  - Chest-Supported Row 3x8–10
  - Lateral Raise 3x12–15
- Lower B
  - Deadlift: 1x2–3 @ RPE 8, then 3x2–3 @ 90%
  - Front Squat 3x3–5
  - Hip Thrust 3x5–6 heavy
  - Split Squat 2x8/leg
  - Calves 2–3x12–15
  - Core: Cable Woodchop 3x10/side
- Upper B
  - OHP: 1x2–3 @ RPE 8, then 3x2–3 @ 90%
  - Pull-Ups 4xAMRAP leaving 1 rep in reserve
  - Close-Grip Bench 3x5–6
  - Lat Pulldown 3x8–10
  - Face Pull 2–3x12–15
  - Arms finisher: 1 superset x 15–20 reps each (pump work)

Week 10
- Introduce heavy singles @ RPE 8 on main lifts to practice neural readiness, then back-offs:
  - Squat 1x1 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ ~85%
  - Bench 1x1 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ ~85%
  - Deadlift 1x1 @ RPE 8, then 3x2 @ ~85%
  - OHP 1x1 @ RPE 8, then 3x2–3 @ ~85%
- Accessories: 2–3 sets each, keep RPE ~8–9.

Week 11
- If Week 10 singles felt good, add 1–2% load to singles, keep RPE 8; maintain back-offs. If not, repeat Week 10 loads.
- Accessories: maintain, avoid failure.

Week 12 (consolidation/test week without maxing)
- Squat: 1x2 @ RPE 8–8.5; back-off 2x3 @ 82–85%
- Bench: 1x2 @ RPE 8–8.5; back-off 2x3 @ 82–85%
- Deadlift: 1x2 @ RPE 8–8.5; back-off 2x2 @ 82–85%
- OHP: 1x2 @ RPE 8–8.5; back-off 2x2–3 @ 82–85%
- Accessories: minimal, 1–2 sets each. Finish feeling strong, not trashed.

Conditioning and NEAT (Weeks 1–12)
- Zone 2: 1–2x/week, 12–25 minutes (bike/row/run) at conversational pace (RPE 4–5), preferably after upper sessions or on Saturday.
- Optional finishers (choose 1): 
  - 6–10 min EMOM: 6–8 hard calories on bike + 8–10 kettlebell swings
  - 8–10 min steady incline treadmill walk
- Steps: 8–12k/day target to support body composition.

Mobility and Prehab
- Daily 5–8 min: hips (90/90 rotations), ankles (knee-to-wall), T-spine (open books), shoulders (band dislocates).
- On lower days: add hip airplanes, Cossack squats (2x5/side).
- On upper days: add scap CARs, wall slides (2x8–10).

Progression Rules
- Compounds:
  - If last set ≤ RPE target and bar speed good, add 1.25–2.5 kg upper body, 2.5–5 kg lower body next exposure.
  - If overshoot RPE by >0.5, keep load and try to improve reps/technique before adding.
- Accessories: Double progression in given rep ranges; when all sets hit top of range at target RPE, add the smallest load next week.

Recovery
- Sleep: 7–9 hours/night; consistent schedule.
- Rest days: light walking + mobility. Avoid back-to-back hard conditioning before deadlift day.
- Soreness management: easy cycling or 10-minute walks post-lower sessions; gentle foam rolling as desired.
- Deload cues: If persistent fatigue, sleep disruption, or performance drops >5–7% for a week, reduce accessory volume by 30–40% for 1 week and cap RPE 7 on compounds.

Nutrition (general body recomposition)
- Calories:
  - If current body weight is stable, start ~200–300 kcal deficit if fat loss is a priority; if strength priority, start at maintenance and let NEAT do the work.
  - Target rate: 0.25–0.5% body weight loss per week if cutting. Adjust by ±150–200 kcal based on 2-week trends.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day (distribute 3–5 meals). Include 25–40 g protein within 1–2 hours pre- and/or post-training.
- Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day (higher on training days; include 30–60 g pre-lift).
- Fats: 0.6–1.0 g/kg/day (don’t drop too low).
- Fiber: 25–35 g/day; hydration: 30–40 ml/kg/day; electrolytes in heat.
- Creatine monohydrate: 3–5 g/day, daily. Beta-alanine optional (3.2–6.4 g/day in divided doses) if she tolerates paresthesia.
- Caffeine: 2–3 mg/kg 30–60 min pre-lift as desired; avoid late-day if it affects sleep.

Lifestyle and Tracking
- Track loads, reps, and RPE each session.
- Weekly check-ins: body weight trend (3–4 morning measurements averaged), energy, sleep, appetite, soreness, cycle symptoms (expected minimal here), and adherence.
- Photos and waist/hip measurements every 2–4 weeks for body composition.
- Form audit: film top sets of squat/bench/dead/OHP weekly for technique review.

Warm-Up Example for Squat Day
- 5 min bike
- Dynamic: leg swings, ankle rocks, 90/90, 1–2 Cossack sets
- Squat ramp: empty bar x 10, 40% x 5, 55% x 3, 70% x 2, 80% x 1, then work sets

Notes for the combined oral contraceptive context
- No need to phase training with cycle; recovery and performance should be scheduled as above.
- Monitor individual responses to higher-intensity weeks as with any client; adjust calories and sleep if recovery lags.

If you want, I can convert each week into printable session checklists with %1RM estimates once you log a Week 1 baseline.
